english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for disbelief or suspicion about whether something is true.
Use 懷疑 as the all-purpose noun for suspicion or doubt.

examples.english: I have some doubt about what he said.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 keoi5 gong2 ge3 je5 jau5 waai4 ji4

examples.english: I have some suspicion about what he said.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 deoi3 keoi5 gong2 ge3 je5 jau5 waai4 ji4
